json.evidence: Photos 1, 5, 9, 11, 12, 14 show the round meter mounted in a compact socket enclosure directly below/beside the larger gray disconnect and BASE inverter panel. The meter can itself appears as a small, standard round-socket housing, not a tall/wide can.
